headline: Liability translation
description: A bounded bridge between recommendation risk, generated-buffer review, and the questions operations or policy teams would ask before calling a system acceptable.

analysis.claim_boundary: This surface translates public recommendation and buffer signals into a review posture. It is not an underwriting decision and it does not replace legal counsel.

loss_channels.name: Compulsive recommendation pressure
loss_channels.why: Short-cycle repetition and high completion patterns can become youth-safety or platform-duty questions.

loss_channels.name: Protected content release
loss_channels.why: A blocked protected signature is a direct cue that rights-handling needs to stay close to generation.

loss_channels.name: Manual review burden
loss_channels.why: Dense recommendation loops and repeated edges often create more human review work even before a public incident appears.

recommended_controls: Route generated media through a rights review lane before release.
Add friction, diversity injection, and late-night safeguards to the recommendation flow.
Budget for manual review and keep causal traces attached to repeated recommendation paths.
Keep release authority close to the evidence trail rather than relying on post-release cleanup.
